title: Global Quality Scorecard
description: The genuinely-new CROSS-STAGE aggregation layer. Per-stage gate verdicts ALREADY exist (analysis_check_verdict, the blocking_gates in graph.yaml, drift_gate); this artifact ROLLS those existing per-stage verdicts (via stage_scorecard) up into one run-level view and derives a deterministic can_finish. It is an AGGREGATOR ONLY: it reads existing verdicts, it does NOT re-run or replace any gate, and can_finish is an internal completeness signal — it NEVER overrides the director's human gates (/promote-to-vault, /idea-bet), which remain the sole deciders to bet, publish, or write the DB. can_finish is derived: it is true ONLY when every required dimension passes (allOf-enforced — structurally impossible to finish with a failing required dimension).

stage_scorecards.description: The per-stage rollups feeding this global view. Each item is a stage_scorecard-shaped object (same shape as stage_scorecard.schema.json).

dimensions.description: The six global quality dimensions, each rolled up across the stages that bear on it. Every dimension is REQUIRED and carries a pass bit derived from the underlying per-stage verdicts. These six are the required set the can_finish AND ranges over.

can_finish.description: Derived: AND over every required dimension's pass bit. true ONLY when all six dimensions pass (allOf-enforced). This is the machine's completeness signal — NOT a publish/bet/promote decision (those remain the director's human gates).

blocking_reasons.description: Human-readable reasons can_finish is false — names each failing required dimension. Empty iff can_finish is true.

pass.description: True iff every per-stage verdict bearing on this dimension passed. Derived, never hand-set.

evidence_ref.description: Pointers to the stage(s) / verdict(s) this dimension was rolled up from (anti-slop).

blocking_reasons.description: Per-dimension reasons this dimension failed (empty when pass is true).

allOf.description: can_finish:true requires EVERY required dimension pass:true. Encoded as: if can_finish is true, then each of the six dimensions must have pass:const true. Structurally impossible to 'finish' with any failing required dimension.
